summary: A Quote client on an equity whose tk snapshot carries no average price, trade quantity, book totals or OI: the Quote frame leaves them out rather than sending 0. A tf delta then brings a new price and a buy total without a feed time: the total appears, and the new price does not take the earlier packet's time (ltt falls back to the receipt time); the next delta with a time brings it.

notes: Audit R107-10 (codex/WEBSOCKET_PARITY_REVIEW_1.0.7.md): a per-packet time never carries over to a new price; the review's coverage table asks AliceBlue for an absent-field sequence.
AliceBlue (Noren) leaves a field it has no value for out of tk and tf.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt: epoch seconds, and a string ("1794302700"); the protocol's WebSocket timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). On the tf with a new price and no ft the web sends the earlier packet's time from its snapshot: a per-packet time never carries over to a new price (lead rule, .lane/107/decisions.md and review-fixes.md; audit R107-10). The desktop sends the time in ms, as a number, and for the price without its time the time it made the tick, as for any packet without one.

The web's Quote sends average_price 0.0, then 0, for a tick whose snapshot never carried ap (parsed_data.get("average_price", 0.0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).
The web's Quote sends total_oi 0 for an equity whose ticks carry no toi; a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).

AliceBlue's tick carries last_quantity (ltq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.

AliceBlue's tick carries total_buy_quantity (tbq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.
